From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call exec recap: HelionTech discovery & procurement path

Samantha / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick executive recap from our conversation and proposed next steps for you and your procurement team.

Summary of business outcomes discussed:
- Reduce time-to-insight for customer support queries by ~60% via Redwood-powered summarization + semantic search.
- Cut per-interaction inference cost by ~30% compared to current baseline through batching, caching, and quantization profiles.
- Improve SLA for critical real-time flows (target P95 latency < 120ms) for the support assistant.

Top pain points we heard:
1) High latency on peak traffic causing escalations for priority accounts.
2) Lack of observability into per-route token costs and regressions after model updates.
3) Procurement constraints around data residency and SOC 2 evidence for audit.

Risk & mitigation (brief):
- Security/compliance: Redwood Private (VPC) + KMS integration meets your residency needs; we'll provide SOC 2 Type II report and a short architecture diagram (attached).
- Performance: We'll validate P95 latency with a 2-week pilot using a scaled Dedicated pool and provide a runbook for graceful degradation.
- Cost: Early batching/caching settings will be tuned during the pilot to hit the 30% unit-cost target; we'll monitor token breakdown in the Console.

Procurement path & timeline you outlined:
- Decision owner: Samantha (Exec Sponsor)
- Procurement contact: Ellen Park (legal/procurement) — Ellen to confirm required PO/contract templates and timeline.
- Proposed timeline: Pilot start Aug 1 -> Exec review Aug 18 -> Production rollout Sept (subject to procurement).

Attachments: redwood-exec-recap-heliontech.pdf (3 slides: outcomes, pilot plan, SOW outline); initial-sow-outline.docx (draft).

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Samantha: confirm procurement contact and any required contract terms (Ellen?)
- Ellen: share required PO/contract templates and any security evidence checklist items we should prioritize.
- Marissa: schedule pilot kickoff (2 weeks) and confirm technical ramp plan with Aditya.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a 30-min procurement sync and attach the short SOW draft.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Quick technical supplement — thanks Laura & team for leading. A couple of items to flag from the engineering side:

1) Data residency: for the pilot we'll propose a VPC-deployed control plane with customer-managed keys. We'll include the architecture diagram in the SOC package. Implementation effort: 2 dev-days to spin up environment, then 3 days to validate KMS integration and audit logs.
2) Latency validation: to reach P95 <120ms we recommend a Dedicated pool with an initial capacity for 200 concurrent sessions and an automated burst policy. That configuration will be part of the pilot acceptance criteria.
3) Security questionnaire: I can take point on the technical responses; Marissa — can you own collecting legal/procurement items from Ellen once we have the templates?

I'll draft a short technical runbook and share by EOD Fri (attached first-pass).
